title: Ghost and Drop
author: Lena Dunmore
blurb: Hazel Thornbury, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
